How we moderate reviews

We remove spam, abuse, personal details and advertising. We never remove negative reviews.

This site publishes reviews of Vantro written by Australian punters. For those reviews to be worth reading, we follow a short set of rules and apply them the same way to praise and to complaints. Below is what we remove, what we never remove and how the scores are worked out. Moderation is handled by the site's editor, Liam Carter.

How moderation works

Every new review is read by a person, not just a filter. Checks usually take up to 24 hours. We look at three things: whether the review describes the writer's own experience, whether it breaks any of the rules below, and whether the same person is posting the same story more than once. We don't fix typos or rewrite anything: a review goes live the way it was written.

What we remove

  • Spam, advertising and links to other sites.
  • Abuse, threats and personal attacks on staff by name.
  • Personal details: phone numbers, account or card numbers, addresses — yours or anyone else's.
  • Repeat reviews from the same person about the same issue.
  • Reviews whose main point is a big win or easy money.
  • Paid reviews, or reviews written on behalf of the operator.

If a review contains personal details but is otherwise fine, we hide those details and let the writer know, rather than removing the whole review.

What we never remove

Negative reviews and complaints about withdrawals, verification or support stay up. We don't hide low ratings, we don't push positive reviews to the top, and we show every review newest first. Vantro cannot ask us to take down a review it doesn't like.

Vantro's replies

Vantro can reply to any review. The reply is published underneath and labelled as coming from the operator. We don't edit reviews or replies, and a reply never appears above the punter's own words.

How we make money

We earn a commission when you join Vantro through our links. It doesn't depend on ratings and doesn't affect which reviews we publish or the order they appear in. If that ever changes, we'll say so on this page.

Ratings on this site

The average and the topic scores — payouts, verification, support, the app — are calculated automatically from every published review. We never change them by hand, and we don't drop older reviews to improve the numbers.

If you disagree with a decision

Get in touch through the form on Write a review and tell us which review it's about. We'll read it again and reply within a few days. This site is for people aged 18 and over. If gambling stops being fun, free and confidential support is available at gamblinghelponline.org.au, and you can exclude yourself from every licensed provider through BetStop.
